stem.text: The enzyme maltase speeds up the reaction between maltose and water.
Which statement describes the **specificity** of maltase?

A.text: Maltase is a biological catalyst and it is a type of protein.

B.text: Maltase is most effective between pH 6.1 and pH 6.8.

C.text: Maltase lowers the activation energies of the reactions it catalyses.

D.text: Maltase only speeds up a small number of chemical reactions.
